name: Phantasm (Compendium Imaginarium)
body:
Phantasm CR 5

XP 1,600
CE Medium undead (incorporeal)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 90 ft., lifesense; Perception +14
Aura unnatural aura (30 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 20, flat-footed 16 (+5 deflection, +5 Dex)
hp 47 (5d8+25)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +6
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +2, incorporeal; Immune undead traits
Weaknesses sunlight powerlessness

OFFENSE

Speed fly 90 ft. (good)
Melee incorporeal touch +3 (1d8 negative energy plus 1d4 Con drain)

STATISTICS

Str —; Dex 20, Con —; Int 14; Wis 14; Cha 21
Base Atk +3; CMB +6; CMD 21
Feats Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative
Skills Diplomacy +10, Fly +7, Intimidate +13, Perception +14, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +11
Languages Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Constitution Drain (Su)

Creatures hit by a phantasm’s touch attack must succeed on a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Constitution drain. On each successful attack, the phantasm gains 3 temporary hit points. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Lifesense (Su)

A phantasm) notices and locates living creatures within 90 feet, just as if it possessed the blindsight ability.

Unnatural Aura (Su)

Animals do not willingly approach within 30 feet of a phantasm), unless a master makes a DC 25 Handle Animal, Ride, or wild empathy check.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure none

A phantasm is created when a sentient being whom has killed an innocent of its own race dies in due to non-violent causes. The angst and turmoil of the unresolved murder can sometimes cause a phantasm) to emerge from the body of the deceased murderer.
